items.source: Annotation to allow String based type aliases to be used when writing type information for PersistentEntitys.
items.translation: 注释允许在编写 String 基础类型的类型别名时使用这些别名，以用于 PersistentEntity。

items.source: Core annotations being used by Spring Data.
items.translation: Spring Data 使用的核心注解。

items.source: Annotation to define how Spring Data shall access values of persistent properties.
items.translation: 注解，用于定义 Spring Data 如何访问持久化属性的值。

items.source: Declares a field as the one representing the principal that created the entity containing the field.
items.translation: 声明一个字段为代表创建包含该字段的实体的主体。

items.source: Declares a field as the one representing the date the entity containing the field was created.
items.translation: 声明一个字段，该字段表示包含此字段的实体被创建的时间。

items.source: Demarcates an identifier.
items.translation: 标识符的界定。

items.source: Annotation for persistent entities to indicate the class is designed in immutable way.
items.translation: 为持久实体添加注解，以表明该类采用不可变方式设计。

items.source: Declares a field as the one representing the principal that recently modified the entity containing the field.
items.translation: 声明一个字段，该字段代表最近修改了包含该字段的实体的主体。

items.source: Declares a field as the one representing the date the entity containing the field was recently modified.
items.translation: 声明一个字段，该字段表示包含此字段的实体最近被修改的日期。

items.source: Marker annotation to declare a constructor or factory method annotation as factory/preferred constructor annotation.
items.translation: 使用标记注解来声明构造函数或工厂方法注解为工厂/首选构造函数注解。

items.source: Annotation to generally identify persistent types, fields and parameters.
items.translation: 用于一般性地标识持久化类型、字段和参数的注解。

items.source: Meta-Annotation to mark a store specific annotation as a query annotation.
items.translation: 元注释：用于将特定于商店的注释标记为查询注释。

items.source: Marks a field to be read-only for the mapping framework and therefore will not be persisted.
items.translation: 将字段标记为映射框架中的只读，因此该字段不会被持久化。

items.source: Meta-annotation to be used to annotate annotations that mark references to other objects.
items.translation: 用于标注其他对象引用的元注释。

items.source: Marks a field to be transient for the mapping framework.
items.translation: 标记该字段为映射框架的瞬态字段。

items.source: Demarcates a property to be used as version field to implement optimistic locking on entities.
items.translation: 指定用于在实体上实现乐观锁的版本字段。
